The direction and lever arms of these contact forces are coordinated in a circular pattern to produce torque, but (nearly) zero net linear force.
理解扭矩和力之间的关系非常重要。任何施加于物体的力都能产生线性加速度和扭矩。当然，净力和扭矩决定了物体的加速度。图 12.19 中的两个关键示例说明了这一点。左侧，力沿着通过质心的直线作用，因此没有扭矩。在这种情况下， sin⁡ϕ=0 表示力的作用线与杠杆臂平行。图 12.19 的右侧显示了另一种极端情况：两个大小相等但方向相反的力作用在相反的杠杆臂上。一对像这样协调的力称为力偶，它们产生净扭矩，但净线性力为零。当你用扳手拧螺栓时，你实际上是在施加两个或多个接触力。这些接触力的方向和杠杆臂以圆形模式协调，从而产生扭矩，但净线性力（几乎）为零。

Figure 12.19  图 12.19 On the left, the line of action passes through the center of mass, resulting in linear acceleration but no torque. On the right, a couple produces a torque but no linear acceleration.
左图中，作用线穿过质心，产生线性加速度，但没有扭矩。右图中，力偶产生扭矩，但没有线性加速度。

In a digital simulation, torques can come from multiple sources. One common source is an applied (linear) force at some lever arm, with collisions being the most common source of torques of all. An impulsive force applied to an object can result in an angular impulse (also known as impulsive torque). Similar to a linear impulse, an angular impulse is an instantaneous change in angular momentum, and we can think of this as the result of a large torque acting for a small duration. We might also instruct the physics engine to automatically apply torques (perhaps limited to some maximum magnitude) on an object in order to enforce some angular constraint. Angular springs and motors are examples of this. Finally, we might have a reason to add a torque at will to any object without there being any corresponding linear force.
在数字模拟中，扭矩可以来自多个来源。一个常见的来源是施加在某个杠杆臂上的（线性）力，其中碰撞是最常见的扭矩来源。施加在物体上的脉冲力会产生角脉冲（也称为脉冲扭矩）。与线性脉冲类似，角脉冲是角动量的瞬时变化，我们可以将其视为大扭矩作用于短时间的结果。我们还可以指示物理引擎自动对物体施加扭矩（可能限制为某个最大值），以强制执行某些角度约束。角弹簧和马达就是这方面的例子。最后，我们可能有理由随意地向任何物体施加扭矩，而无需任何相应的线性力。

Back to our thought experiment with the mass attached to the rotating disk. What if we fix the lever arm l , and instead vary r , the radial distance between the mass and the pivot? The same principle of the lever is at work, but in reverse. The force (and therefore the tangential acceleration a⊥ ) experienced by the mass will be inversely proportional to r . Said another way, the effective inertia of the mass—its resistance to linear acceleration—is proportional to r . But what about the ability of the apparatus to resist angular acceleration? How does its moment of inertia change as we vary r ? The moment of inertia is not proportional to r , it is proportional to r2 ! To see why, consider that if we increase l and r by the same factor, then the tangential acceleration a⊥ experienced by the mass is unchanged. However, at this increased radius, the same tangential acceleration now corresponds to a reduced angular acceleration, due to the relation α=a⊥ / r .
回到我们将质量块连接到旋转圆盘上的思想实验。如果我们固定杠杆臂 l ，并改变 r （质量块与枢轴之间的径向距离）会怎样？杠杆原理相同，但方向相反。质量块所受的力（以及切向加速度 a⊥ ）将与 r 成反比。换句话说，质量块的有效惯性——它对线性加速度的抵抗——与 r 成正比。但是，该装置抵抗角加速度的能力又如何呢？当我们改变 r 时，它的转动惯量如何变化？转动惯量不与 r 成正比，而是与 r2 成正比！为了理解原因，考虑如果我们将 l 和 r 增加相同的倍数，那么质量块所受的切向加速度 a⊥ 保持不变。然而，在这个增加的半径下，由于关系式 α=a⊥ / r ，相同的切向加速度现在对应于减小的角加速度。

In summary, the moment of inertia of an object, which must be measured relative to some particular pivot (in this case, it's the fixed pivot point, but for a rigid body we usually measure it relative to its center of mass), quantifies the degree to which the object will resist angular acceleration about that pivot. The moment of inertia J of a point mass is proportional to its mass and proportional to the square of the distance from the mass to the pivot.
总而言之，物体的惯性矩必须相对于某个特定枢轴（在本例中是固定的枢轴点，但对于刚体，我们通常相对于其质心进行测量）进行测量，它量化了物体抵抗绕该枢轴角加速度的程度。点质量的惯性矩 J 与其质量成正比，也与质量到枢轴距离的平方成正比。

Moment of Inertia of a Point Mass in the Plane
平面上点质量的惯性矩
J=mr2.

Now imagine that the disk in our thought experiment has multiple masses placed on it. Each of these masses contributes to the disk's resistance to rotation, and their contribution is the same, regardless of where any force is applied. To compute the moment of inertia of an arbitrary rigid body, we break up the object into “mass elements” such that for each element we know the mass mi and radial distance to the center of mass ri . We then sum up the moments of inertia of each individual mass element:
现在想象一下，在我们的思想实验中，圆盘上放置了多个质量块。每个质量块都会对圆盘的旋转阻力产生贡献，并且无论力施加在何处，它们的贡献都是相同的。为了计算任意刚体的转动惯量，我们将物体分解为“质量元素”，这样我们知道每个元素的质量 mi 和到质心的径向距离 ri 。然后，我们将每个质量元素的转动惯量相加：

Moment of inertia of a rigid body
刚体的转动惯量
(12.25)J=∑iJi=∑imiri2.

Let's work through a few instructive examples.
让我们来看几个有启发性的例子。

Figure 12.20  图 12.20 Distribution of mass can affect the moment of inertia. Each of the examples above has the same total mass.
质量分布会影响转动惯量。以上每个示例的总质量相同。

Consider the four disks in Figure 12.20. Since each disk has three masses, we start by expanding the sum in Equation (12.25) to J=m1 r1 2+m2 r2 2+m3 r3 2 :
考虑图 12.20 中的四个圆盘。由于每个圆盘的质量为 3，我们首先将公式 (12.25) 中的和展开为 J=m1 r1 2+m2 r2 2+m3 r3 2 ：

  1. (a) J=2⋅32+2⋅22+2⋅12=18+8+2=28 ;  （一） J=2⋅32+2⋅22+2⋅12=18+8+2=28 ；
  2. (b) J=2⋅32+2⋅32+2⋅32=18+18+18=54 ;  （b） J=2⋅32+2⋅32+2⋅32=18+18+18=54 ；
  3. (c) J=3⋅32+2⋅22+1⋅12=27+8+1=36 ;  （c） J=3⋅32+2⋅22+1⋅12=27+8+1=36 ；
  4. (d) J=1⋅32+2⋅22+3⋅12=9+8+3=20 .  （d） J=1⋅32+2⋅22+3⋅12=9+8+3=20 。

Aside from the rote practice this example provides, it highlights a crucial fact: the distribution of mass within the object can have a profound effect on the moment of inertia. Notice the widely differing moments of inertia, despite the fact that each of these disks has a total mass of 6. Compare this to linear inertia, where shifting the mass around will not make the object any easier or harder to accelerate. The only thing that matters for linear acceleration is the total mass. Furthermore, in three dimensions, although linear mass can still be quantified with a scalar, the moment of inertia cannot be described by a single number, due to its dependence on the distribution of mass.
这个例子除了提供死记硬背的练习之外，还强调了一个关键事实：物体内部的质量分布会对转动惯量产生深远的影响。请注意，尽管每个圆盘的总质量为 6，但转动惯量却差异很大。将其与线性惯性进行比较，在线性惯性中，改变质量不会使物体加速更容易或更困难。对于线性加速度，唯一重要的因素是总质量。此外，在三维空间中，虽然线性质量仍然可以用标量来量化，但由于转动惯量依赖于质量分布，因此无法用一个数字来描述。

When we take the limit as the number of mass elements reaches infinity, Equation (12.25) turns into an integral. Luckily, formulas for the moments of inertia for many common shapes, such as spheres, cylinders, rings, and so forth, can be found on the Internet.
当我们取质量元素数量无穷大的极限时，公式 (12.25) 就变成了一个积分。幸运的是，许多常见形状（例如球体、圆柱体、环形等）的惯性矩公式都可以在网上找到。

Newton's second law, F=ma , has a straightforward rotational equivalent.
牛顿第二定律 F=ma 有一个简单的旋转等效定律。

Rotational Equivalent of Newton's Second Law
牛顿第二定律的旋转等效
(12.26)τ=Jα.

For rotation in a plane, all of the variables in Equation (12.26) are scalars. In three dimensions, however, τ and α become vector quantities, and J becomes a matrix. Section 12.5.3 discusses this.
对于平面旋转，公式 (12.26) 中的所有变量都是标量。然而，在三维空间中， τ 和 α 变为矢量， J 变为矩阵。第 12.5.3 节对此进行了讨论。

We've considered torque, the rotational analog to linear force. Now let's turn our attention to momentum. Remember that linear momentum is the “quantity of motion” contained in an object. Its analog, angular momentum, has a similar interpretation. Intuitively, angular momentum describes how hard it will be to stop the rotation of the object. If the angular momentum is large, then the magnitude of the applied torque, or the duration for which it is applied, or both, must be large.
我们已经讨论了扭矩，它是线性力的旋转类似物。现在让我们把注意力转向动量。记住，线性动量是物体所包含的“运动量”。它的类似物角动量也有类似的解释。直观地说，角动量描述的是停止物体旋转的难度。如果角动量很大，那么施加扭矩的大小，或施加扭矩的持续时间，或两者兼而有之，也必然很大。

In our discussion of linear momentum, we encountered two ways of thinking about momentum. The first was to interpret momentum in an “instantaneous respect” as the product of mass and velocity by using P=mv . The rotational equivalent is shown in Equation (12.27).
在讨论线性动量时，我们遇到了两种思考动量的方式。第一种是使用 P=mv 将动量从“瞬时”的角度解释为质量与速度的乘积。其旋转等效式如公式 (12.27) 所示。

Spin Angular Momentum  自旋角动量

Angular momentum ( L ) is the product of the moment of inertia J and angular velocity ( ω ):
角动量 ( L ) 是转动惯量 J 与角速度 ( ω ) 的乘积：

(12.27)L=Jω.

Alternatively, we can compute the angular momentum for an individual point mass directly from its linear momentum by
或者，我们可以直接从单个点质量的线性动量计算其角动量

Relationship between linear and angular momentum
线性动量和角动量的关系
(12.28)L=rPsin⁡ϕ,

where P is the linear momentum. The purpose of the sin⁡ϕ term is the same as in the computation of torque: it isolates the tangential motion. If the trajectory is known to be orbital, this term can be omitted since it will always be unity. Notice that since Equation (12.28) contains a factor r , it really is only for orbital angular momentum. Equation (12.27) can also be used for orbital angular momentum, provided that J and ω are both measured relative to the same pivot, but Equation (12.27) is probably more appropriate for spin angular momentum of a rigid body, where J measures the moment of inertia of the entire body. In any case, the spin angular momentum of a rigid body can be computed by breaking the object into mass elements and taking the sum of the orbital angular momenta of these elements. Here are several ways in which the sum could be accomplished:
其中 P 是线性动量。 sin⁡ϕ 项的作用与计算扭矩时相同：它隔离了切向运动。如果已知轨迹是轨道的，则可以省略该项，因为它始终为 1。请注意，由于公式 (12.28) 包含因子 r ，因此它实际上仅适用于轨道角动量。公式 (12.27) 也可用于轨道角动量，前提是 J 和 ω 都是相对于同一枢轴测量的。但公式 (12.27) 可能更适合刚体的自旋角动量，其中 J 测量的是整个物体的转动惯量。无论如何，刚体的自旋角动量可以通过将物体分解为质量单元，并对这些质量单元的轨道角动量求和来计算。以下是几种求和的方法：

Spin angular momentum of a rigid body
刚体的自旋角动量
L=ωJ=ω (∑iJi) =∑iJiω=∑i( ri 2mi)ω=∑irimi(riω)=∑irimivi=∑iriPi=∑iLi.

Here the subscripted variables refer to values for a particular particle. Note that we dropped the sin⁡ϕ term under the assumption that each particle is in an orbital trajectory.
这里下标变量指的是特定粒子的值。注意，我们假设每个粒子都处于轨道上，因此删除了 sin⁡ϕ 项。

The second interpretation of linear momentum that we discussed is that of momentum as the time integral of force. When we apply force over time, linear momentum is accumulated. A similar relationship exists between angular momentum and torque. As torque is applied over time, it builds up angular momentum; equivalently, torque is equal to the rate of change (derivative) of angular momentum. As with linear momentum, this can be interpreted as a conservation law.
我们讨论过的线性动量的第二种解释是，动量是力的时间积分。当我们随时间施加力时，线性动量就会积累。角动量和扭矩之间存在类似的关系。随着扭矩随时间施加，角动量会积累；等效地，扭矩等于角动量的变化率（导数）。与线性动量一样，这可以解释为守恒定律。

Torque and the Conservation of Angular Momentum
扭矩和角动量守恒
L=∫τ dt,τ= dL dt .

In the absence of external torque, angular momentum is conserved.
在没有外部扭矩的情况下，角动量守恒。

12.5.33D Rotational Dynamics
12.5.33D 旋转动力学

Now let's extend the basic principles developed in Section 12.5.2 into three dimensions. First, let's review the 3D rotational kinematics quantities. The single angle θ is replaced by a rotation tensor of some kind, with a rotation matrix R or a quaternion q being the most common methods of describing orientation in general rigid body simulations. The angular velocity ω and acceleration α become vector quantities and get bolded as ω ω and α α , respectively.
现在，我们将 12.5.2 节中提出的基本原理扩展到三维空间。首先，我们来回顾一下三维旋转运动学量。单个角度 θ 被某种旋转张量取代，而旋转矩阵 R 或四元数 q 是描述一般刚体模拟中方向的最常用方法。角速度 ω 和加速度 α 变为矢量，分别以粗体表示为 ω ω 和 α α 。

To extend the dynamics principles into three dimensions, we start with torque. Not surprisingly, torque becomes a vector quantity denoted τ τ , and the direction of this vector indicates the axis about which the torque is tending to induce rotation. (Later we consider what happens if the object is already rotating about a different axis.) The formula for computing the torque for an applied force f and lever arm l is actually simpler in 3D than the corresponding 2D formula!
为了将动力学原理扩展到三维空间，我们从扭矩开始。扭矩自然会变成一个矢量，记为 τ τ ，该矢量的方向表示扭矩倾向于绕哪个轴旋转。（稍后我们会考虑如果物体已经绕着不同的轴旋转会发生什么。）计算施加力 f 和杠杆臂 l 的扭矩的公式在三维空间中实际上比相应的二维公式更简单！

Torque in Three Dimensions
三维扭矩
(12.29) τ τ = l × f .

Compare Equation (12.29) to τ=Flsin⁡ϕ (Equation (12.24)), and notice that the cross product has the magnitude and sin⁡ϕ terms built in.
将公式 (12.29) 与 τ=Flsin⁡ϕ (公式 (12.24)) 进行比较，并注意到叉积具有内置的幅度和 sin⁡ϕ 项。

Angular momentum likewise becomes a vector L , with a similar formula for its relation to the linear quantity:
角动量同样变成矢量 L ，它与线性量的关系有类似的公式：

Orbital angular momentum of a particle in three dimensions with radial vector r
三维空间中粒子的轨道角动量，径向矢量为 r
L = r × P .

Compare this to Equation (12.28).
将其与公式 (12.28) 进行比较。

A reader who is paying attention might note that Equation (12.28) is only one of two equations we gave for angular momentum in the plane—the one we deemed to be more appropriate for orbital angular velocity of a particle—and wonder about the other formula, Equation (12.27), which was more appropriate for spin angular velocity. That formula was L=Jω , and to get its three-dimensional equivalent, we must understand how to extend J , the moment of inertia, into three dimensions. Luckily, the link between the two momentum equations is an excellent way to get this understanding. Let's start by expanding L = r × P , with the goal of ending up with something that looks like L=Jω :
细心的读者可能会注意到，公式 (12.28) 只是我们给出的两个平面角动量方程中的一个——我们认为这个方程更适合描述粒子的轨道角速度——并且会对另一个公式，公式 (12.27)，更适合描述自旋角速度感到疑惑。这个公式是 L=Jω ，为了得到它的三维等价公式，我们必须了解如何将 J （转动惯量）扩展到三维空间。幸运的是，这两个动量方程之间的联系是理解这一点的绝佳途径。让我们从展开 L = r × P 开始，目标是得到类似于 L=Jω 的结果：

L = r × P = r ×(m v )=(m r )× v =(m r )×(ω× r )=m [ rx ry rz ] × [ ωyrz−ωzry ωzrx−ωxrz ωxry−ωyrx ] =m [ ry(ωxry−ωyrx)−rz(ωzrx−ωxrz) rz(ωyrz−ωzry)−rx(ωxry−ωyrx) rx(ωzrx−ωxrz)−ry(ωyrz−ωzry) ] =m [ ryωxry−ryωyrx−rzωzrx+rzωxrz rzωyrz−rzωzry−rxωxry+rxωyrx rxωzrx−rxωxrz−ryωyrz+ryωzry ] =m [ (ry2+rz2)ωx−ryrxωy−rzrxωz −rxryωx+(rz2+rx2)ωy−rzryωz −rxrzωx−ryrzωy+(rx2+ry2)ωz ] = (m [ry2+rz2−ryrx−rzrx−rxryrz2+rx2−rzry−rxrz−ryrzrx2+ry2] ) [ ωx ωy ωz ] .

The key point is in the last line, which bears a striking resemblance to L=Jω . In fact, the quantity in parenthesis is the three-dimensional moment of inertia.
关键点在最后一行，它与 L=Jω 惊人地相似。实际上，括号里的量是三维转动惯量。

Inertia Tensor  惯性张量
The inertia tensor of a mass m with radial vector r is
质量为 m 且径向矢量为 r 的惯性张量为
(12.30) J =m [ry2+rz2−ryrx−rzrx−rxryrz2+rx2−rzry−rxrz−ryrzrx2+ry2] .

Notice that this quantity is a matrix, not a vector. In recognition of this, in three dimensions we sometimes refer to the moment of inertia as the inertia tensor. This mathematical artifact is a result of the physical fact that an object's resistance to rotational acceleration is anisotropic: it can be easier to rotate an object about one axis compared to another. For example, compare the torque required to spin a piece of rebar around like a helicopter versus rolling it about its lengthwise axis.
请注意，这个量是一个矩阵，而不是向量。鉴于此，在三维空间中，我们有时将惯性矩称为惯性张量。这种数学概念源于一个物理事实：物体对旋转加速度的阻力具有各向异性：绕一个轴旋转物体可能比绕另一个轴旋转物体更容易。例如，比较一下使一根钢筋像直升机一样旋转所需的扭矩和使其绕其纵向轴滚动所需的扭矩。

Notice that J is a symmetric matrix. One trivial (but thankful) consequence of this is that we can be sloppy with row and column vectors, while ordinarily we must be very careful in order to avoid transposed results.19 Before we look at some other properties of J , let's finish extending the basic formulas in three dimensions with perhaps the most important one.
注意， J 是一个对称矩阵。由此带来的一个微不足道（但值得庆幸）的结果是，我们可以随意处理行向量和列向量，而通常情况下，我们必须非常小心，以避免转置结果。19 在讨论 J 的其他属性之前，让我们先用也许是最重要的一个公式来扩展它在三维空间中的基本公式。

In the plane, the rotational equivalent of Newton's second law, F=ma , is τ=Jα . Extending this into three dimensions is straightforward.
在平面上，牛顿第二定律 F=ma 的旋转等效式是 τ=Jα 。将其扩展到三维空间就很简单了。

3D Rotational Analog of Newton's Second Law
牛顿第二定律的三维旋转模拟
τ τ = α α J .

As we've said before, in computer simulations it's often the case that the force and mass are known, and we compute the acceleration using a=F / m . A similar situation exists for rotational dynamics, where division by m is replaced with multiplication by J −1 :
正如我们之前所说，在计算机模拟中，通常情况下力和质量是已知的，我们使用 a=F / m 计算加速度。旋转动力学也存在类似的情况，其中除以 m 会被乘以 J −1 取代：

α α = τ τ J −1 .

As it turns out, the inverse inertia tensor is needed more frequently in digital simulations than is J , and it is usually precomputed and stored.
事实证明，在数字模拟中，逆惯性张量比 J 更常见，并且通常是预先计算和存储的。

Equation (12.30) tells us how to compute the inertia tensor for a point mass, but what about more complicated shapes? In a manner similar to how we computed the center of mass, we can imagine breaking up a compound object into a large number of mass elements and taking the sum of their individual moments of inertia. Taking the limit as the volume of the largest element approaches zero, this sum becomes a multidimensional integral. Such integrals are typically difficult or impossible to solve analytically, except for abstract primitives such as boxes, disks, cylinders, spheres, cones, and the like. Fortunately, such primitives arise commonly in practice and can make adequate approximations. Even more fortunate for us is the fact that the hard work of solving the integral has already been done for a large variety of primitives. For such primitives, the best method for obtaining the moment of inertia is to look up the formula in a table. (At the time of this writing, such a table can be found on wikipedia.org under “List of moment of inertia tensors.”)
公式 (12.30) 告诉我们如何计算点质量的惯性张量，但对于更复杂的形状呢？类似于计算质心的方式，我们可以想象将一个复合物体分解成大量质量元素，并取它们各自惯性矩的总和。当最大元素的体积趋近于零时，取极限，该和就变成了一个多维积分。这类积分通常很难甚至不可能用解析解来求解，除非是一些抽象的几何体，例如长方体、圆盘、圆柱体、球体、圆锥体等等。幸运的是，这类几何体在实践中很常见，并且可以给出足够的近似值。更幸运的是，对于各种各样的几何体，求解积分的艰苦工作已经完成了。对于这类几何体，获取惯性矩的最佳方法是查阅表格中的公式。（在撰写本文时，可以在 wikipedia.org 的“惯性矩张量列表”下找到这样的表格。）

More complicated objects are typically approximated by breaking down the object into primitives with known formulas, calculating their moments of inertia individually, and then summing together the results. There is just one complication. The formulas for these primitives assume the origin of the coordinate space is at some auspicious location, such as at the center of the sphere. But imagine we are computing the moment of inertia of a human body and approximating the head by a sphere. Odds are low that we chose to place the origin in the center of the head. Luckily the parallel axis theorem tells us how the moment of inertia changes if we translate a mass.
更复杂的物体通常通过以下方式近似计算：将物体分解成具有已知公式的基元，分别计算它们的转动惯量，然后将结果相加。但有一个复杂之处。这些基元的公式假设坐标空间的原点位于某个合适的位置，例如球体的中心。但想象一下，我们正在计算人体的转动惯量，并用球体近似头部。我们选择将原点置于头部中心的可能性很小。幸运的是，平行轴定理告诉我们，如果我们平移一个质量，转动惯量会如何变化。

Assume that J cm is the inertia tensor of some object with mass m , measured relative to its center of mass. The inertia tensor J ′ of the mass measured relative to some arbitrary pivot that has a displacement [x,y,z] from this center of mass is given by Equation (12.31).
假设 J cm 是某个质量为 m 的物体相对于其质心测量的惯性张量。该物体相对于某个与质心位移 [x,y,z] 的任意支点测量的惯性张量 J ′ 由公式 (12.31) 给出。

Parallel Axis Theorem  平行轴定理
(12.31) J ′= J cm +m [y2+z2−xy−xz−xyx2+z2−yz−xz−yzx2+y2] .

12.5.4Collision Response with Rotations
12.5.4 旋转碰撞响应

Now let us complete the collision response calculation we started in Section 12.4.2. At that time we did not consider rotational effects, but now we know better. We continue, following Hecker [8].
现在让我们完成在 12.4.2 节开始的碰撞响应计算。当时我们没有考虑旋转效应，但现在我们对此有了更清楚的了解。我们继续遵循 Hecker [8] 的方法。

Remember the basic strategy:
记住基本策略：

  1. Compute the relative velocities at the point of contact.
    计算接触点的相对速度。
  2. Project the relative velocities onto the surface normal. This is the velocity that must be counteracted in order to prevent (further) penetration.
    将相对速度投影到表面法线上。为了防止（进一步）穿透，必须抵消该速度。
  3. Compute k , the magnitude of an impulse, such that when we apply the impulse to both objects (in opposite directions) parallel to the surface normal, the post-collision velocities, measured along the surface normal, have the desired magnitude according to some collision law. This discussion will be based upon Newton's collision law and the coefficient of restitution e .
    计算冲量的幅值 k ，使得当我们以与表面法线平行的方式将冲量（方向相反）施加到两个物体上时，沿表面法线测量的碰撞后速度将根据某些碰撞定律达到所需的幅值。本讨论将基于牛顿碰撞定律和恢复系数 e 。
  4. Apply the impulse k n to one object and −k n to the other.
    对一个物体施加脉冲 k n ，对另一个物体施加脉冲 −k n 。

Dealing with objects that can rotate adds a few complications. First, we earlier referred to “the” velocity of an object. But when an object is rotating, the different points on the object have different linear velocities. The velocity we need is not the velocity of the object's center of mass, but rather the velocity at the point of contact. So we must extend our velocity calculation to account for the angular velocity. Likewise, our prediction of the post-impulse velocities at the points of impact must also take into consideration rotational effects. Application of an impulse at the point of contact will create an angular impulse, which will change the rate of rotation. In general, when objects are free to rotate, a smaller impulse will suffice to resolve the collision, since the impulse has two ways by which to reduce the point velocities. The change in angular velocity will cause the points of contact to move away from each other faster than their centers of mass do. Indeed, the centers of mass may still be moving towards each other after the collision.
处理可旋转的物体会增加一些复杂性。首先，我们之前提到了物体的“速度”。但是，当物体旋转时，物体上不同点的线速度会有所不同。我们需要的速度不是物体质心的速度，而是接触点的速度。因此，我们必须扩展速度计算以考虑角速度。同样，我们对撞击点后冲量速度的预测也必须考虑旋转效应。在接触点施加冲量会产生角冲量，从而改变旋转速度。通常，当物体可以自由旋转时，较小的冲量就足以解决碰撞，因为冲量有两种降低点速度的方式。角速度的变化会导致接触点彼此远离的速度比其质心远离的速度更快。事实上，碰撞后，质心可能仍在彼此靠近。

In Section 12.4.2, we started with the equation
在第 12.4.2 节中，我们从以下等式开始

v rel ′⋅ n =−e v rel ⋅ n

and then expanded the math and solved for k , the magnitude of the impulse. (It's hidden in the left hand side.) The same strategy works here, only we need to derive new expressions for the point velocities before and after the impulse that take into consideration the rotational effects. First, let's check the notation. We use r i to denote the position of the point of impact on object i relative to its center of mass, ω ω i for the angular velocity of the object, mi for the mass, and J i for the inertia tensor. For linear velocity, we need to introduce some new notation to distinguish between the linear velocities at the point of contact, which we denote as u i , and the linear velocities of the center of mass, denoted v i . As before, primes on the quantities refer to their values after the collision.
然后扩展数学并求解 k ，即冲量的幅度。 （它隐藏在左侧。）同样的策略在这里也有效，只是我们需要推导出考虑旋转效应的冲量之前和之后点速度的新表达式。首先，让我们检查一下符号。我们使用 r i 表示撞击点相对于物体 i 的质心的位置， ω ω i 表示物体的角速度， mi 表示质量， J i 表示惯性张量。对于线速度，我们需要引入一些新的符号来区分接触点的线速度（我们将其表示为 u i ）和质心的线速度（表示为 v i ）。和以前一样，数量上的撇号是指碰撞后的值。

With this notation, we compute the point velocity of each object by adding the velocity due to the motion of the center of mass, plus that portion caused by the rotation, according to Equation (11.31):
利用这种符号，我们根据公式 (11.31)，通过将质心运动引起的速度加上旋转引起的速度部分来计算每个物体的点速度：

Computing the point velocities
计算点速度
u 1= v 1+ ω ω 1× r 1, u 2= v 2+ ω ω 2× r 2.

The velocities after the collision depend on the change in linear velocity of the center of mass, and also the change in angular velocity. These are computed by
碰撞后的速度取决于质心线速度的变化，以及角速度的变化。这些变化由下式计算得出：

Post-impulse linear and angular velocities of the bodies
物体的脉冲后线速度和角速度
v 1′= v 1−k n / m1, v 2′= v 2+k n / m2, ω ω 1′= ω ω 1−( r 1×k n ) J 1 −1 , ω ω 2′= ω ω 2+( r 2×k n ) J 2 −1 ,

where the sign conventions are determined by our arbitrary choice to have the collision normal n point from the first object to the second. Combining the equations above, we get the post-impulse point velocities:
其中，符号约定由我们任意选择碰撞法线 n 点从第一个物体指向第二个物体而决定。结合上述方程，我们得到冲量后点速度：

u 1′= v 1′+ ω ω 1′× r 1= v 1−k n / m1+( ω ω 1−( r 1×k n ) J 1 −1 )× r 1= v 1−k n / m1+ ω ω 1× r 1−k(( r 1× n ) J 1 −1 )× r 1=( v 1+ ω ω 1× r 1)−k n / m1−k(( r 1× n ) J 1 −1 )× r 1= u 1−k n / m1−k(( r 1× n ) J 1 −1 )× r 1, u 2′= u 2+k n / m2+k(( r 2× n ) J 2 −1 )× r 2.
Post-impulse velocities at the point of contact
接触点处的脉冲后速度

Defining u rel = u 1− u 2 as the relative point velocity, we are now ready to grind through the algebra:
定义 u rel = u 1− u 2 为相对点速度，我们现在可以开始计算代数了：

−e u rel ⋅ n = u rel ′⋅ n ,−e u rel ⋅ n =( u 1′− u 2′)⋅ n ,−e u rel ⋅ n =[ ( u 1−k n / m1−k(( r 1× n ) J 1 −1 )× r 1)−( u 2+k n / m2+k(( r 2× n ) J 2 −1 )× r 2) ]⋅ n ,−e u rel ⋅ n =[ ( u 1− u 2)−k n / m1−k n / m2−k(( r 1× n ) J 1 −1 )× r 1)−k(( r 2× n ) J 2 −1 )× r 2) ]⋅ n ,−e u rel ⋅ n = u rel ⋅ n −k[ (1 / m1+1 / m2) n +(( r 1× n ) J 1 −1 )× r 1)+(( r 2× n ) J 2 −1 )× r 2) ]⋅ n ,−(e + 1) u rel ⋅ n =−k[ (1 / m1+1 / m2) n +(( r 1 × n ) J 1 −1 )× r 1)+(( r 2 × n ) J 2 −1 )× r 2) ]⋅ n .

With one more step, we have the formula we're seeking.
再进一步，我们就得到了我们想要的公式。

Collision Response with Rotation
旋转碰撞响应
The magnitude of the collision impulse can be calculated from the relative point velocity, masses, moments of inertia, surface normal, and coefficient of restitution, by
碰撞冲量的幅值可以通过相对点速度、质量、转动惯量、表面法线和恢复系数计算得出，计算公式如下：
k= (e + 1) u rel ⋅ n [(1 / m1+1 / m2) n +(( r 1 × n ) J 1 −1 )× r 1)+(( r 2 × n ) J 2 −1 )× r 2)]⋅ n .

Equation (12.32) assumes that all vectors are measured in the same coordinate space and that the inverse inertia tensors operate on vectors in that same space. However, the inverse inertia tensor is a constant only in body space, and the same matrix in world space may not be updated continually as the object rotates. Our convention is to describe the orientation of the object by using R , a rotation matrix that transforms row vectors on the left from body space to upright space. Under these assumptions, in Equation (12.32) we would replace J −1 with R T J −1 R .
方程 (12.32) 假设所有向量均在同一坐标空间中测量，并且逆惯性张量作用于同一空间中的向量。然而，逆惯性张量仅在体空间中为常数，而世界空间中的同一矩阵可能不会随着物体旋转而持续更新。我们习惯用 R 来描述物体的方向，这是一个旋转矩阵，它将左侧的行向量从体空间变换到直立空间。基于这些假设，我们将方程 (12.32) 中的 J −1 替换为 R T J −1 R 。

12.6Real-Time Rigid Body Simulators
12.6 实时刚体模拟器

This section presents an overview of real-time rigid body simulators such as PhysX, Havok, Bullet Physics, and the Open Dynamics Engine. Few game programmers will work directly on the physics engine, and certainly far fewer will write one from scratch. Most of us just need to know how to use the thing. Luckily, in this regard the physics engines previously listed have much in common. However, a physics engine is like many other programming tools: even if you don't intend to write one, you can use it more effectively if you have a basic understanding of how things work under the hood.
本节概述了实时刚体模拟器，例如 PhysX、Havok、Bullet Physics 和 Open Dynamics Engine。很少有游戏程序员会直接使用物理引擎，更不用说从零开始编写物理引擎了。我们大多数人只需要知道如何使用物理引擎。幸运的是，在这方面，前面列出的物理引擎有很多共同之处。然而，物理引擎就像许多其他编程工具一样：即使您不打算编写物理引擎，如果您对其底层工作原理有基本的了解，也可以更有效地使用它。

We regret that we won't be able to go into great detail, for a few reasons. First, any attempt to describe “how a physics engine works” is complicated by the fact that currently there is still great diversity and rapid innovation in the field. Second, the math quickly becomes more advanced than is appropriate for this introductory book. Frankly, your authors simply do not have enough expertise to succinctly summarize the state of the art from top to bottom. However, from a user's perspective, there are many similarities between physics engines that can be covered in an introductory manner, so we start with an overview of a typical physics engine interface. There are also a few choice mathematics that are discussed near the end of this chapter.
很遗憾，由于以下几个原因，我们无法进行深入探讨。首先，由于目前该领域仍然存在巨大的多样性和快速的创新，任何描述“物理引擎如何工作”的尝试都很复杂。其次，数学很快就会变得比这本入门书更高级。坦率地说，你们的作者根本没有足够的专业知识来从上到下简明扼要地总结最新的技术水平。但是，从用户的角度来看，物理引擎之间有很多相似之处，可以用介绍的方式涵盖，因此我们首先概述一个典型的物理引擎界面。本章结尾处还会讨论一些精选的数学知识。

12.6.1Physics Engine State Variables
12.6.1 物理引擎状态变量

An old computer science adage attributed to Fred Brooks says, “Show me your flow charts and conceal your tables, and I shall continue to be mystified. Show me your tables, and I won't usually need your flowcharts; they'll be obvious.” Despite the image of a banner printed on Z-fold paper using The Print Shop that is evoked by the arcane terminology, the essence of the message is still true today: to write or understand software, a good place to start is a description of the data that are being operated on. From the perspective of the user of a physics engine, there are three main types of data objects within a rigid body simulator: the dynamics bodies, collision geometry data, and constraints. Let's examine each of these in turn.
弗雷德·布鲁克斯 (Fred Brooks) 有一句古老的计算机科学谚语：“给我看你的流程图，藏起你的表格，我会继续感到困惑。给我看你的表格，我通常就不需要你的流程图了；它们一目了然。” 尽管用 The Print Shop 在 Z 形折叠纸上打印的横幅形象令人联想到晦涩难懂的术语，但这句话的本质在今天仍然适用：要编写或理解软件，一个好的起点是对正在操作的数据的描述。从物理引擎用户的角度来看，刚体模拟器中有三种主要类型的数据对象：动力学体、碰撞几何数据和约束。让我们依次研究一下这三种类型。

Dynamics body state. Perhaps the most fundamental type of data object within a real-time rigid-body simulator is the dynamics body. You can think of the dynamics body as the “soul” of a rigid body: it tells it where to go, but it has no outward appearance, so you can see it only indirectly via the effects it has. The collision geometry (to be discussed later) is what gives a rigid body its “earthly form,” meaning its shape. The part of a rigid body that we see is usually some sort of graphical model, which doesn't have anything to do with the physics engine and is not discussed here.
动力学刚体状态。在实时刚体模拟器中，最基本的数据对象类型或许是动力学刚体。你可以将动力学刚体视为刚体的“灵魂”：它指示刚体的去向，但它没有外观，因此你只能通过其产生的效果间接地看到它。碰撞几何（稍后讨论）赋予刚体“实体形态”，即其形状。我们看到的刚体部分通常是某种图形模型，与物理引擎无关，本文不作讨论。

At this point, it's probably important to discuss the relationship between a dynamics body and an “object” in the nontechnical (and nonprogramming) sense of the word. A simple rigid object, such as the ubiquitous video game crates Old Man Murray was so fond of reporting sighting, can be simulated by using a single dynamics body. A more complicated object with moving parts, such as a car or human body, is not a rigid body and thus cannot be simulated with a single dynamics body. Instead, the object must be broken down into rigid parts, and then the dynamics bodies corresponding to those parts connected via joint constraints, to be discussed later. Of course, the graphical representation for such a compound object like this need not be “rigid,” but within the physics simulation, each dynamics body is a rigid body.
此时，从非技术（和非编程）的意义上讨论一下动态刚体和“对象”之间的关系可能很重要。一个简单的刚性物体，比如老默里（Old Man Murray）非常喜欢用来报告目击事件的无处不在的电子游戏盒子，可以用单个动态刚体来模拟。而具有运动部件的更复杂物体，比如汽车或人体，不是刚体，因此无法用单个动态刚体来模拟。相反，必须将物体分解为多个刚性部件，然后通过关节约束连接与这些部件对应的动态刚体，这将在后面讨论。当然，这种复合对象的图形表示不必是“刚性的”，但在物理模拟中，每个动态刚体都是一个刚体。

Another way that a dynamics body is like a soul is that it's easier to just list its properties rather that attempt a precise definition. So let's enumerate the variables that comprise a dynamics body. We classify these variables by their life cycle, meaning when those variables are initialized and how often their values change. Certain properties are (mostly) constant, some change continuously over the life of the object, and some are working variables, coming into existence (or reset) at the start of a simulation time step and being thrown away at the end of the time step.
动力学刚体如同灵魂的另一个原因是，与其尝试精确定义，不如直接列出其属性。因此，让我们列举构成动力学刚体的变量。我们根据变量的生命周期（即变量的初始化时间和值的变化频率）对这些变量进行分类。某些属性（大部分）是恒定的，有些属性会在对象的整个生命周期内持续变化，有些属性是工作变量，在模拟时间步开始时生效（或重置），并在时间步结束时被丢弃。

The first class of properties are those that are initialized when the body is instantiated by the application, and typically (but not necessarily) remain constant during the simulation.
第一类属性是在应用程序实例化主体时初始化的属性，并且通常（但不一定）在模拟期间保持不变。

  • The mass and inertia tensor are certainly critical properties of a rigid body, and often these do not change over the course of the simulation, although there is no inherent reason why they cannot be changed by the application over time, for example, to simulate a car burning fuel. As stated earlier, it's frequently the inverse mass and tensor that are actually needed by a simulation, so these are often kept on hand as additional derived quantities so that they do not need to be recomputed every time they are needed. Also, the inertia tensor, being a rotation, is a constant only if it operates on vectors expressed relative to the body axes of the rigid body. Relative to the world axes, the inertia tensor varies continuously as the body rotates.
    质量和惯性张量无疑是刚体的关键属性，并且通常它们不会在模拟过程中发生变化，尽管没有内在原因导致应用程序不能随时间改变它们，例如，模拟汽车燃烧燃料。如前所述，模拟实际需要的往往是质量和张量的倒数，因此它们通常作为额外的派生量保留，这样就不需要在每次需要时重新计算。此外，惯性张量是一种旋转，只有当它作用于相对于刚体轴表示的矢量时才是常数。相对于世界轴，惯性张量随着物体的旋转而连续变化。
  • Sometimes the physics engine can store an offset of the center of mass of the object (which, like the inertia tensor, is constant only in the body space of the object). We noted earlier that for reasons of numeric stability and simplicity, internally a physics engine might prefer to assume the origin of the body space is its center of mass, and this center of mass offset is taken into consideration in the client interface routines.
    有时，物理引擎会存储物体质心的偏移量（与惯性张量类似，该偏移量仅在物体的体空间中为常数）。我们之前提到，出于数值稳定性和简单性的原因，物理引擎内部可能倾向于将体空间的原点假设为其质心，并在客户端接口例程中考虑此质心偏移量。
  • Each body is associated with one or more collision geometry objects, the union of which defines the shape of the rigid body, as discussed below.
    每个刚体都与一个或多个碰撞几何对象相关联，这些对象的联合定义了刚体的形状，如下所述。

The second class of variables that define the state of the dynamics body are those that evolve over time, and contain some “history” in them and must be carried forward from one frame to the next. If we need to save the complete state of the simulation and resume it later (for example, in a save game), these variables cannot be derived from any other source and must be serialized:
第二类定义动态刚体状态的变量是那些随时间演变的变量，它们包含一些“历史记录”，必须从一帧传递到下一帧。如果我们需要保存模拟的完整状态并在稍后恢复（例如，在游戏存档中），这些变量不能从任何其他来源获取，必须进行序列化：

  • position,   位置，
  • orientation,   方向，
  • linear velocity,   线速度，
  • angular velocity.   角速度。

This list reflects a choice to make velocities the primary state variables, in which case the momentums are easily derived quantities. An alternate strategy is to use the momentum as the primary state variable and velocity as the derived quantity. The former approach has an advantage in dealing with kinematically controlled objects, whose inertia (and therefore momentum) is considered infinite. The latter can more elegantly deal with the situation in which the mass changes over time, since conservation of momentum is automatically enforced.
此列表反映了将速度作为主要状态变量的选择，在这种情况下，动量是易于导出的量。另一种策略是将动量用作主要状态变量，将速度用作导出量。前一种方法在处理运动学控制的物体时具有优势，因为这些物体的惯性（以及动量）被认为是无限的。后者可以更优雅地处理质量随时间变化的情况，因为动量守恒会自动生效。

Finally, each dynamics body has certain properties that are stored in working variables. These quantities change over time but do not inherently have “history” integrated into them. These sorts of variables are often reset at some point within the simulation step. If we wanted to save the state of the simulation and resume it later, it is usually not necessary20 to include these variables in the state description:
最后，每个动力学刚体都具有存储在工作变量中的某些属性。这些量会随时间变化，但本质上并不包含“历史记录”。这类变量通常会在模拟步骤中的某个时刻重置。如果我们想要保存模拟状态并在稍后恢复，通常无需在状态描述中包含这些变量：

  • force and torque accumulators,
    力和扭矩蓄能器，
  • linear and angular impulse accumulators,
    线性和角度脉冲累加器，
  • list of current contact constraints.
    当前接触约束列表。

We use the word “accumulators” here to reflect what often happens in practice. These values are often reset to zero at some point within the frame, and then different sources of external forces are polled, and the net result stored in these variables.
我们在这里使用“累加器”一词来反映实际中经常发生的情况。这些值通常在框架内的某个时刻被重置为零，然后轮询不同的外力源，并将最终结果存储在这些变量中。

Listing 12.2 is a structure that summarizes the essentials of a dynamics body state and hints at how it might be implemented in C++. These variable names are used in the pseudocode later in this chapter. You should compare this to the corresponding class in a real physics engine implementation to see what additional data that engine chose to keep on hand, or what different choices were made.
清单 12.2 是一个结构体，它概括了动态刚体状态的要点，并提示了如何在 C++ 中实现它。这些变量名将在本章后面的伪代码中使用。您应该将其与实际物理引擎实现中对应的类进行比较，以了解引擎选择保留哪些额外数据，或者做出了哪些不同的选择。

struct DynamicsBody {

    //
    // Primary quantities
    //

    // Position of center of mass
    Vector3 pos;

    // Orientation in quaternion format
    Quaternion rotQuat;

    // Mass
    float mass;

    // Moment of inertia, expressed in body space.
    Matrix3x3 jBody;

    // Velocities
    Vector3 linVel;
    Vector3 angVel;

    //
    // Derived quantities
    //

    // Orientation, in matrix form
    Matrix3x3 rotMat;

    // Inverse mass and inertia tensor
    float oneOverMass;
    Matrix3x3 invJBody;


    //
    // Temporary / working variables
    //

    // Force accumulators.  Cleared to zero each time step
    Vector3 force;
    Vector3 torque;
    Vector3 linImpulse;
    Vector3 angImpulse;

    //
    // Collision and constraint lists
    //
    vector userConstraints;
    vector collisionShapes;
};

Collision Geometry. If the dynamics body is the soul of a rigid object, the collision geometry is its earthly manifestation. The collision geometry is used to define the shape of dynamics bodies, and also of other “soulless” or static objects. Typically, a physics engine will support a number of different primitives. In order of complexity, these are
碰撞几何体。如果说动态刚体是刚体的灵魂，那么碰撞几何体就是其实体化的表现。碰撞几何体用于定义动态刚体以及其他“无灵魂”或静态物体的形状。通常，物理引擎会支持多种不同的基元。按复杂度排序，这些基元如下：

  • basic abstract primitives such as spheres, boxes, planes, cylinders, cones, and the like;
    基本抽象图元，如球体、盒子、平面、圆柱体、圆锥体等；
  • convex polyhedra;   凸多面体；
  • arbitrary collision mesh, sometimes called a “triangle soup.”
    任意碰撞网格，有时被称为“三角汤”。

The simpler shapes have advantages in both speed and stability, which is why it's often best to build up a concave or complicated shape from multiple primitives. These primitives are allowed to penetrate each other; only their union matters, since two geometry objects attached to the same dynamics body will not collide with each other. Indeed, it's important for the physics engine to provide flexibility in deciding which pairs of geometry objects collide; for example, on a character, the thigh part might not collide with the connected torso and shin parts, but it might collide against every other part in the body. Or, under the auspices of the first law of video game physics, we might create a barrier that enemies can pass through but the player character cannot.
简单的形状在速度和稳定性方面都具有优势，这就是为什么通常最好使用多个基元来构建凹形或复杂形状。这些基元可以相互穿透；只有它们的并集才重要，因为附加到同一个动态体上的两个几何对象不会相互碰撞。事实上，物理引擎在决定哪些几何对象对发生碰撞时提供灵活性非常重要；例如，在一个角色上，大腿部分可能不会与连接的躯干和小腿部分碰撞，但它可能会与身体的其他所有部位碰撞。或者，在电子游戏物理第一定律的支持下，我们可以创建一个敌人可以穿过但玩家角色不能穿过的屏障。

A collision geometry object either will be associated with a single dynamics body, to which it has a fixed relative position and orientation, or will not be associated with any dynamics body and is part of the static “world.”
碰撞几何对象要么与单个动态体相关联，并具有固定的相对位置和方向，要么不与任何动态体相关联并且是静态“世界”的一部分。

Constraints. The third and final main type of object within a rigid body simulator is a constraint. Constraints are used to enforce relationships between pairs of rigid bodies, or between a rigid body and the world. Applications can create two types of user constraints: joints and motors. A third type of constraint is the contact constraint, which is involved in collision response.
约束。刚体模拟器中第三种也是最后一种主要对象类型是约束。约束用于强制执行刚体对之间或刚体与世界之间的关系。应用程序可以创建两种类型的用户约束：关节和马达。第三种约束是接触约束，它与碰撞响应有关。

User constraints are the “regular” kind of constraints that are specified by the application in order to maintain some desired relationship. The more common and easily understood type of constraint maintains a spatial relationship between two parts and is known as a joint. Some examples of the types of joints that come built-in to most physics engines are the following.
用户约束是应用程序为了维持某种所需关系而指定的“常规”约束。更常见且易于理解的约束类型维持两个部分之间的空间关系，称为关节。以下是大多数物理引擎内置的一些关节类型的示例。

  • A ball-and-socket joint constrains two objects such that a shared point maintains a fixed position relative to each set of body axes. Alternatively, you can think of one object having a ball at a fixed location in its body space, and the other as having a socket in its body space, and the constraint attempts to force those points to be coincident.
    球窝关节约束两个物体，使它们共享一个点，使其相对于每组躯干轴保持固定的位置。或者，你可以想象一个物体在其躯干空间的固定位置上有一个球，另一个物体在其躯干空间中有一个窝，约束会尝试强制这两个点重合。
  • A hinge joint is a ball-and-socket joint with an additional constraint that two axes, one connected to the ball and the other to the socket, must be collinear. Thus the two objects can rotate about the shared axis like a hinge. Additionally, limits may be set on the hinge rotation angle.
    铰链关节是一种球窝关节，但附加了一个约束：两个轴（一个连接到球，另一个连接到窝）必须共线。因此，两个物体可以像铰链一样绕共用轴旋转。此外，还可以设置铰链旋转角度的限制。
  • A slider joint or prismatic joint operates on two axes that are fixed relative to the body space of the two objects, constraining them to be collinear. The objects may only slide back and forth along this axis, or perhaps twist along it. Limits may be applied to the range of the translation.
    滑动关节或平移关节作用于两个相对于两个物体的本体空间固定的轴，从而将它们约束在共线位置。物体只能沿着该轴前后滑动，或者也可以沿着该轴扭转。平移范围可能会受到限制。
  • A universal joint is similar to a ball and socket joint, but allows for limits to be specified on the angles of rotation. The angular limits are Euler angles (think heading and pitch), resulting in a rectangular range of motion. Limits on the twisting (“bank”) can also be enforced.
    万向节类似于球窝关节，但允许指定旋转角度的限制。角度限制是欧拉角（例如航向和俯仰），从而产生矩形运动范围。扭转（“倾斜”）的限制也可以强制执行。
  • A conical joint is similar to a universal joint, but the rotation limits are conical rather than rectangular.
    圆锥接头类似于万向接头，但旋转限制是圆锥的而不是矩形的。

As an example, in a human skeleton, each “bone” may be simulated as a separate rigid body, with constraints used to attach each bone to its parent. Hinge joints might be used at the knees, with limits set up to prevent the
例如，在人体骨架中，每根“骨骼”都可以模拟为一个独立的刚体，并使用约束将每根骨骼连接到其父骨骼上。膝盖处可以使用铰链关节，并设置限制以防止

knee from bending backwards. Conical joints or perhaps universal joints might be used for the hips and shoulders.
防止膝盖向后弯曲。对于臀部和肩部，可以使用锥形关节或万向关节。

Whereas a joint constraint is concerned with the position and orientation of the bodies, a motor is a type of constraint that attempts to enforce a requested relative velocity between two bodies. For example, by using the proper kind of motor, an application can instruct the physics engine: “Body A should maintain an angular speed ω , relative to the axis n ^ , which is fixed in the reference frame of body B.”
关节约束关注的是刚体的位置和方向，而马达则是一种试图在两个刚体之间强制执行所请求的相对速度的约束。例如，通过使用合适的马达，应用程序可以指示物理引擎：“刚体 A 应保持角速度 ω ，相对于刚体 B 参考系中固定的轴 n ^ 。”

Most physics engines have a variety of constraints, and even mechanisms for adding your own types of constraints. Furthermore, constraints need not be absolute, but the physics engine can be given instructions to limit the force that may be applied to enforce the constraint. Most physics engines provide a mechanism by which a constraint may be queried for the amount of force that was applied in the attempt to satisfy the constraint. This query can be quite useful, for example, to play a sound if a motor is straining, or perhaps destroy a joint if some threshold is exceeded. Joints and their limits can also be “soft.” For example, in the Open Dynamics Engine, values known as the error reduction parameter (ERP) and constraint force mixing (CFM) parameter can be tuned to cause the joint to behave like a spring-damper system.
大多数物理引擎都具有各种约束，甚至还有添加自定义约束类型的机制。此外，约束不必是绝对的，但可以指示物理引擎限制为强制执行约束而施加的力。大多数物理引擎都提供了一种机制，通过该机制可以查询约束，了解为满足约束而施加的力的大小。这种查询非常有用，例如，当电机过载时播放声音，或者当超过某个阈值时破坏关节。关节及其限制也可以是“软的”。例如，在开放动力学引擎中，可以调整称为误差减少参数 (ERP) 和约束力混合 (CFM) 参数的值，使关节的行为类似于弹簧阻尼系统。

Although application constraints don't necessarily have any “memory” and can be created and destroyed at will by the application—for example to detach a wheel from a car or an arm from a body—they typically persist across time steps. Contact constraints, in contrast, are instantiated by the physics engine and are always destroyed within the same physics time step. (Conceptually, at least. They may survive internally for performance or stability reasons.) They are used to enforce nonpenetration between the collision geometry of two bodies (or of a body and some static geometry). These constraints are the primary output of the collision detection system and the mechanism by which collision response is performed.
虽然应用程序约束不一定具有任何“内存”，并且可以由应用程序随意创建和销毁（例如，从汽车上拆下车轮或从身体上拆下手臂），但它们通常会跨时间步长持续存在。相比之下，接触约束由物理引擎实例化，并且始终在同一物理时间步长内销毁。（至少在概念上如此。它们可能出于性能或稳定性原因在内部保留。）它们用于强制两个物体（或一个物体与某个静态几何体）的碰撞几何体之间不穿透。这些约束是碰撞检测系统的主要输出，也是执行碰撞响应的机制。

Although contact constraints are created by the physics engine during collision detection, that doesn't mean the application cannot be involved in the process. Physics engines provide numerous hooks to customize the creation of these contact points and notify the application when contact constraints are applied to a dynamics body. These hooks are a powerful means for fine-grained customization of how particular pairs of objects interact, and collision notifications are essential for implementing feedback such as sound and particle effects or a reduction in hit points.
虽然接触约束是由物理引擎在碰撞检测期间创建的，但这并不意味着应用程序无法参与此过程。物理引擎提供了许多钩子函数来自定义这些接触点的创建，并在接触约束应用于动态刚体时通知应用程序。这些钩子函数是精细定制特定对象对交互方式的强大工具，而碰撞通知对于实现诸如声音和粒子效果或减少生命值等反馈至关重要。

This section presented the three main “tables” of data in a physics engine. The next section covers the “flowcharts”—and we hope that you and Fred Brooks don't think they are too “obvious.”
本节介绍了物理引擎中三个主要的数据“表”。下一节将介绍“流程图”——希望您和 Fred Brooks 不会觉得它们太“明显”。

12.6.2HighLevel Overview  12.6.2 高层概述

The APIs presented by modern physics engines, through which you can manipulate the “tables” from the previous section, show significant similarity. However, their inner workings are more diverse. This is the point at which we must really begin using generalities and waving our hands. This section starts by presenting some high-level pseudocode of how a physics engine fits into the game loop. Afterwards, we briefly discuss a few general strategies for what happens inside of the heart of the physics engine.
现代物理引擎提供的 API（您可以通过它们来操作上一节中的“表格”）表现出显著的相似性。然而，它们的内部工作原理却更加多样化。这正是我们必须真正开始运用通用性并付诸实践的时刻。本节首先介绍一些高级伪代码，说明物理引擎如何融入游戏循环。然后，我们将简要讨论物理引擎核心内部运作的一些通用策略。

We begin with the game loop itself, which is summarized by Listing 12.3.
我们从游戏循环本身开始，如清单 12.3 所示。

void gameLoop() {
    getReady();
    while (!gameOver) {
        simPrePhysics();
        physicsEngine->update();
        simPostPhysics();
        render();
    }
}

Let's describe the physics-related work that goes on in each of the “functions” in this listing. First, in getReady(), along with the usual loading of textures and models, we also create objects within the physics system of the three main types discussed in Section 12.6.1. The world will likely have a large amount of collision geometry. Each simple simulated object might have one dynamics body and one or a few collision shapes. A complex articulated model might require several dynamics bodies, linked together with joint constraints, and collision geometry for each body. For the player character, we might set up a carefully tuned constraint used to pull the character towards a desired position each frame.
让我们描述一下此清单中每个“函数”中进行的物理相关工作。首先，在 getReady() 中，除了通常的纹理和模型加载外，我们还在 12.6.1 节中讨论的三种主要类型的物理系统中创建对象。世界可能会包含大量的碰撞几何体。每个简单的模拟对象可能都有一个动态体和一个或几个碰撞形状。一个复杂的铰接式模型可能需要多个动态体，它们通过关节约束链接在一起，并且每个动态体都需要碰撞几何体。对于玩家角色，我们可能会设置一个精心调整的约束，用于将角色在每一帧中拉向所需的位置。

Inside the game loop, we have broken the simulation into three steps. First, there is a glob of activities we do before calling the physics engine, which we have lumped together under simPrePhysics(). Here we prepare the inputs to physics processing. We might process kinematically controlled objects and notify the physics system of their new positions and velocities. We would read the player input; determine where those controls indicate the player should be; and update the constraints, forces, or torques used by the physics engine to attempt to move the player character into position. In a network game, we might poll the network for objects for which the local host is not the authority, and update a constraint that tells the physics engine, “Try to get the object to go here.” Also, the physics objects do not all need to be created once in getReady() and live forever. We can certainly add and remove objects from the physics universe at any time.
在游戏循环中，我们将模拟分为三个步骤。首先，在调用物理引擎之前，我们会进行一系列活动，这些活动都归入 simPrePhysics() 函数中。在这里，我们准备物理处理的输入。我们可能会处理运动控制的物体，并将它们的新位置和速度通知物理系统。我们会读取玩家的输入；确定这些控制指示玩家应该在的位置；并更新物理引擎使用的约束、力或扭矩，以尝试将玩家角色移动到位。在网络游戏中，我们可能会轮询网络中本地主机没有权限的对象，并更新一个约束，告知物理引擎“尝试让对象移动到此处”。此外，所有物理对象不必在 getReady() 函数中创建一次并永久存在。我们当然可以随时在物理世界中添加和移除对象。

Next, we invoke the physics engine to do its thing. Although most of this code is in the physics engine itself, it will communicate back with the game code for several purposes, either just for notification, or perhaps to provide customization opportunities to the application. We review a few different approaches that are used by physics engines later in this section.
接下来，我们调用物理引擎来执行操作。虽然大部分代码都位于物理引擎内部，但它会出于多种目的与游戏代码进行通信，例如通知，或者为应用程序提供自定义功能。本节稍后将回顾物理引擎使用的几种不同方法。

When the physics engine is complete, some miscellaneous steps need to happen that we have grouped together under the function simPostPhysics(). Perhaps the most important step is to update our game objects with the new positions and orientations that have been determined by the physics engine. We might do this by looping through all the objects and polling the physics engine for the updated position. Or we might receive notification in the form of a callback. The updated object positions are not the only output of the physics update. We might also be interested in the forces that were required to maintain constraints, or the list of collisions that occurred. Depending on the game design, and how the camera is simulated, we often update the camera after the physics has completed, so that it moves in response to the player movement.
物理引擎完成后，需要执行一些杂项步骤，我们将它们归类到 simPostPhysics() 函数下。或许最重要的步骤是使用物理引擎确定的新位置和方向来更新游戏对象。我们可以通过循环遍历所有对象并轮询物理引擎以获取更新后的位置来实现这一点。或者，我们也可以以回调的形式接收通知。更新后的对象位置并非物理更新的唯一输出。我们可能还会关注维持约束所需的力，或者发生的碰撞列表。根据游戏设计和摄像机的模拟方式，我们通常会在物理引擎完成后更新摄像机，以便它能够响应玩家的移动而移动。

Finally, of course, at some point we need to draw the scene, as indicated by the presence of the function render().
最后，当然，在某些时候我们需要绘制场景，正如函数 render() 的存在所表明的那样。

In our pseudocode, physicsEngine->update() represents the heart of the physics engine. As we've mentioned, no two physics engines work exactly the same, but there are some common themes. Here we briefly outline a few strategies, summarizing the more in-depth survey of Erleben et al. [5].
在我们的伪代码中，physicsEngine->update() 代表了物理引擎的核心。正如我们之前提到的，没有两个物理引擎的工作原理完全相同，但也有一些共同的主题。这里我们简要概述了一些策略，总结了 Erleben 等人 [5] 的更深入的研究。

Penalty Methods. Penalty methods resolve collisions with a spring-likemechanism. The collision detection provides a list of penetrating collision shapes. For each pair, we locate the dynamics bodies that own these shapes and apply a repulsive force to each, where the magnitude of this force is proportionate to the penetration depth. In other words, the penalty method does not attempt to resolve collisions on the same time step that they are detected; rather, over time the force will cause the objects to separate. Of course, we must tune our “springs” carefully; for stacked objects, the spring force will balance with gravity when the objects are in equilibrium, so in general the penalty method does not attempt to completely eliminate penetration, but rather just to limit it to an acceptable level. Listing 12.4 shows a simplified version of how this could be done.
惩罚方法。惩罚方法使用类似弹簧的机制来解决碰撞。碰撞检测提供了一个穿透碰撞形状的列表。对于每一对，我们找到拥有这些形状的动态刚体，并对每个形状施加排斥力，该力的大小与穿透深度成正比。换句话说，惩罚方法不会尝试在检测到碰撞的同一时间步长上解决碰撞；相反，随着时间的推移，力会导致物体分离。当然，我们必须仔细调整“弹簧”；对于堆叠的物体，当物体处于平衡状态时，弹簧力将与重力平衡，因此通常惩罚方法不会尝试完全消除穿透，而只是将其限制在可接受的水平。清单 12.4 展示了如何实现此操作的简化版本。

void PhysicsEngine::update() {

    // Gather up external forces acting on the dynamics bodies
    // (i.e. gravity, springs, etc)
    computeForces();

    // Locate penetrating collision geometry, and their owner bodies
    struct Collision {
        DynamicsBody *body1, *body2; // the bodies involved
        Vector3 p; // location of collision
        Vector3 n; // contact normal
        float penetrationDepth;
    };
    vector collisions = collisionDetection();

    // Treat each collision as a spring
    for (each collision) {

        // Calculate a force based on the penetration depth
        Vector3 f = calculateForce(collisions[i]);

        // Add this force to the two bodies
        collisions[i].body1->addForceAtPoint(collisions[i].p, f);
        collisions[i].body2->addForceAtPoint(collisions[i].p, -f);
    }

    // Integrate the forces (accelerations) into velocity, and
    // velocities into position, to move the simulation forward
    integrateForces();
}

Sequential impulse simulations. These methods were popularized by Mirtich [10]. Both resting and colliding contact are modeled as (possibly very high frequency) collisions. When a collision is detected between two objects A and B, a collision law (such as the simple Newton collision model shown in Section 12.5.4) is used to calculate an impulse that will prevent penetration. However, this might result in a different collision, either elsewhere between A and B, or perhaps between B and C, so the process must be repeated until all of the relative velocities at the contacts are resting or separating. Listing 12.5 illustrates the basic idea.
顺序冲量模拟。这些方法由米尔蒂奇 [10] 推广。静止接触和碰撞接触都被建模为（可能非常频繁的）碰撞。当检测到两个物体 A 和 B 之间发生碰撞时，会使用碰撞定律（例如 12.5.4 节中所示的简单牛顿碰撞模型）来计算阻止穿透的冲量。然而，这可能会导致另一种碰撞，要么发生在 A 和 B 之间的其他地方，要么发生在 B 和 C 之间，因此必须重复该过程，直到接触点处的所有相对速度都静止或分离。清单 12.5 演示了其基本思想。

void PhysicsEngine::update() {

    // Gather up external forces acting on the dynamics bodies
    // (i.e. gravity, springs, etc)
    computeForces();

    // Integrate force (acceleration) into velocities, but don't yet
    // update positions
    updateVelocities();

    // Locate colliding bodies
    struct Collision {
        DynamicsBody *body1, *body2; // the bodies involved
        Vector3 p; // location of collision
        Vector3 n; // contact normal
        float penetrationDepth;
    };
    vector collisions = collisionDetection();

    // Keep applying impulses until all
    // relative contact velocity is resolved
    for (;;) {

        // Find a collision where the relative point velocities at
        // the point of contact are such that the bodies are moving
        // towards each other along the normal.  (Colliding contact,
        // rather than resting or separating contact)
        Collision *c = nextUnresolvedCollision(collisions);
        if (c == NULL) break;

        // Calculate an impulse  using a collision law
        Vector3 impulse = calculateCollisionImpulse(c);

        // Apply the impulse to the two bodies.  (This produces an
        // immediate change in the linear and angular velocities)
        c->body1->addImpulseAtPoint(c->p, impulse);
        c->body2->addImpulseAtPoint(c->p, -impulse);

        // Keep looping until all collision velocities are resting
        // or separating
    }

    // Now step the positions forward based on the velocities
    integrateVelocities();
}

The first difficulty is that the order that the contacts are processed (which are often an arbitrary artifact of collision detection) can cause different simulation results. A second is that the simulation can get caught in an infinite loop, so care must be taken to ensure termination.
第一个难点是，处理接触的顺序（通常是碰撞检测的任意结果）可能会导致不同的模拟结果。第二个难点是，模拟可能会陷入无限循环，因此必须小心谨慎地确保终止模拟。

Velocity-based simulations. These techniques currently represent the state of the art in real-time simulations. Preventing penetration and resolving collisions is viewed as a constraint to be satisfied. As mentioned earlier, these constraints are treated in a standardized way with user constraints such as joints and motors. For each constraint, the simulation examines the ratio of the rate of change of satisfaction of the constraint versus changes in linear and angular velocity. Using this information (a matrix of partial derivatives is known as a Jacobian matrix), the simulator solves for the velocities that satisfy the constraints. This is illustrated in Listing 12.6.
基于速度的模拟。这些技术目前代表了实时模拟领域的最新水平。防止穿透和解决碰撞被视为需要满足的约束。如前所述，这些约束与用户约束（例如关节和电机）以标准化的方式处理。对于每个约束，模拟会检查约束满足的变化率与线速度和角速度变化的比率。利用这些信息（偏导数矩阵称为雅可比矩阵），模拟器可以求解满足约束的速度。如清单 12.6 所示。

void PhysicsEngine::update() {

    // Gather up external forces acting on the dynamics bodies
    // (excluding those from the constraints)
    computeForces();

    // Tentatively apply forces, to compute proposed
    // (unconstrained) positions and velocities
    integrateForcesTentatively();

    // Build up list of constraints.  These come from two
    // sources: collision detection (contact constraints) and
    // the user constraints.
    vector constraintRows;
    collisionDetection(constraintRows);
    processApplicationConstraints(constraintRows);

    // Solve for velocities which satisfy the constraints
    solveConstraints(constraintRows);

    // Now really update the positions, based on the computed
    // velocities that satisfied the constraints
    integrateVelocities();
}

The resulting matrix problem is not a standard system of linear equations; rather, it is a system of inequalities. For example, if a collision law predicts that two objects should bounce away with a certain velocity, that velocity is interpreted as a minimum velocity. If some other constraint (say one object is being pulled away by a spring) causes the objects to bounce away faster than predicted by the collision law, this is not considered a violation of the contact constraint. This type of system can be put into a standard form, known as the linear complimentary problem (LCP).
由此产生的矩阵问题并非标准的线性方程组，而是一个不等式组。例如，如果碰撞定律预测两个物体应该以某个速度弹开，则该速度被解释为最小速度。如果其他约束（例如，一个物体被弹簧拉开）导致物体弹开的速度比碰撞定律预测的更快，则这不被视为违反接触约束。这类系统可以转化为标准形式，称为线性互补问题（LCP）。

Various implementations of velocity-based methods borrow ideas from penalty and sequential impulse simulations, so it can sometimes be difficult to classify a simulation as strictly one or the other. The incremental matrix solvers that are used to solve the linear complimentary problem make small adjustments to the velocity of the bodies; these adjustments can be physically interpreted as a series of impulses. Thus, there are some similarities between a velocity-based solver and a sequential impulse solver. The distinction is that in a sequential impulse solver, the collision law is applied multiple times. In a velocity-based simulation, the collision law is applied once in order to determine the ideal relative velocity, and then this velocity is treated as a goal or constraint. Some velocity-based solvers, notably the Open Dynamics Engine, allow constraints to be treated as “soft,” using techniques similar to penalty-based methods.
基于速度的方法的各种实现借鉴了惩罚和顺序脉冲模拟的思想，因此有时很难将模拟严格地归类为其中一种。用于解决线性互补问题的增量矩阵求解器会对物体的速度进行微调；这些调整可以在物理上解释为一系列脉冲。因此，基于速度的求解器和顺序脉冲求解器之间存在一些相似之处。区别在于，在顺序脉冲求解器中，碰撞定律会被应用多次。在基于速度的模拟中，碰撞定律会被应用一次以确定理想的相对速度，然后将该速度视为目标或约束。一些基于速度的求解器，尤其是开放动力学引擎，允许使用类似于基于惩罚的方法的技术将约束视为“软”约束。

12.6.3Euler Integration  12.6.3 欧拉积分

Every physics engine needs to be able to “step forward” in time. We assume that we know the position and velocity values (both linear and angular) at some time t , and we want to determine their values at some future time t+Δt . The outcome will depend on the net forces experienced by the object, and, of course, the initial velocity at time t . The forces themselves may vary depending on the position or the velocity of the body. For example, a body connected to a fixed point by a spring experiences forces that vary based on the position of the body, and a body moving through a fluid such as air experiences a drag force that has some (potentially nonlinear) relationship with the relative velocity of the body and the fluid. Furthermore, the forces can be the result of interactions between bodies (e.g., four bodies connected by springs forming a tetrahedron, with one corner submerged in water). In short, the problem is not trivial.
每个物理引擎都需要能够及时“前进”。假设我们知道某个时间 t 的位置和速度值（线性和角度），并且我们想要确定它们在未来某个时间 t+Δt 的值。结果将取决于物体受到的净力，当然还有时间 t 的初始速度。力本身可能会根据物体的位置或速度而变化。例如，通过弹簧连接到固定点的物体会受到根据物体位置而变化的力，而通过空气等流体移动的物体会受到与物体和流体的相对速度有某种（可能是非线性的）关系的阻力。此外，力可能是物体之间相互作用的结果（例如，四个物体通过弹簧连接形成一个四面体，其中一个角浸入水中）。简而言之，这个问题并不简单。

The mathematical term for this is numerical integration. There are two main parts to our discussion. This section ignores rotation and discusses the basic concepts of integration in terms of linear acceleration and velocity. Section 12.6.4 considers how to integrate angular acceleration and velocity.
数学术语是数值积分。我们的讨论主要分为两部分。本节忽略旋转，并讨论线性加速度和速度积分的基本概念。第 12.6.4 节讨论如何对角加速度和速度进行积分。

Recall that integration is the process of determining a function from its derivative. In our case, we are working with three different functions of time: position, velocity, and acceleration. A reader who was not asleep will remember that velocity is the derivative of position and acceleration is the derivative of velocity. We are dealing with numerical integration because we are not symbolically solving the differential equations. Instead, the derivative function that we know (the acceleration, determined using Newton's second law from the force) is being sampled only at a discrete number of time values. To appreciate the difficulties, we begin with a naïve approach and see where it fails.
回想一下，积分是通过函数的导数来确定函数的过程。在我们的例子中，我们处理的是三个不同的时间函数：位置、速度和加速度。没有睡着的读者会记得，速度是位置的导数，加速度是速度的导数。我们处理的是数值积分，因为我们不是在符号式地求解微分方程。相反，我们已知的导数函数（加速度，由牛顿第二定律根据力确定）仅在离散的时间值上进行采样。为了理解其中的难点，我们先从一种简单的方法入手，看看它在哪里会失效。

Let h denote our step size in seconds ( 1 / h is the simulation frequency, so, for example, if we were running at 60 Hz, h would be 1 / 60 ). The simplest method of integration is to assume that the derivative is constant during the step. Assume that the current time step is the k th time step. Then the position for the next time step, k+1 , is determined by
令 h 表示步长（以秒为单位）（ 1 / h 是模拟频率，例如，如果我们以 60 Hz 运行，则 h 将是 1 / 60 ）。最简单的积分方法是假设导数在该步长内保持不变。假设当前时间步长是第 k 个时间步长。那么下一个时间步长 k+1 的位置由下式确定：

Euler integration of velocity into position
欧拉速度与位置的积分
p k+1 = p k+h v k.

This strategy is known as Euler integration. Although numerical integration may be an “advanced” subject often taught after calculus, Euler integration is easier for most people to understand than true (analytic) integration. It is common practice to use Euler integration to introduce analytic integration, which is exactly what we did in Figure 11.10 to determine the movement of a rabbit, although we didn't call the technique by its name. The key point that was brought out was that simple Euler integration ignores changes in the derivative during the time step, and this is the source of error. As we saw, the most obvious way to reduce the error in the answer is to decrease the step size h . In some cases, we can decrease it to the limit through symbolic manipulations and arrive at a perfect answer (i.e., we use analytic integration). But sometimes we have a complicated function and all we can do is evaluate (“sample”) the function.
这种策略称为欧拉积分。虽然数值积分可能是一门通常在微积分之后教授的“高级”课程，但对于大多数人来说，欧拉积分比真正的（解析）积分更容易理解。通常的做法是使用欧拉积分来引入解析积分，这正是我们在图 11.10 中所做的，用来确定兔子的运动，尽管我们没有用它的名字来称呼这项技术。提出的关键点是，简单的欧拉积分忽略了时间步长内导数的变化，而这正是误差的来源。正如我们所见，减少答案中的误差最明显的方法是减小步长 h 。在某些情况下，我们可以通过符号操作将其减小到极限并得到一个完美的答案（即我们使用解析积分）。但有时我们有一个复杂的函数，我们所能做的就是评估（“采样”）该函数。

Consider three different simulations currently of interest in video games: hair, cloth, and fluid. In each case, we break up the thing being simulated into pieces (“discretize” the problem), and then simulate each piece using a simplified set of force laws. A basic strategy for cloth is to model the cloth as a set of vertices, where each vertex is connected to nearby vertices by “springs” and is affected by drag. The forces experienced by a given vertex in this simulation depend on both the position and velocity of the vertex and its neighbors. Although it is not difficult to calculate the active forces at any given instant, the result cannot be directly integrated because of the dependence on position and velocity. This is what makes it a problem of differential equations rather than simple integration. These differential equations are usually not vulnerable to the frontal assault of analytic solution; we must use numerical integration.
考虑目前电子游戏中三种不同的模拟：头发、布料和流体。在每种情况下，我们都将被模拟的对象分解成多个部分（“离散化”问题），然后使用一组简化的力定律来模拟每个部分。布料的基本策略是将布料建模为一组顶点，其中每个顶点通过“弹簧”连接到附近的顶点，并受到阻力的影响。在此模拟中，给定顶点所受的力取决于该顶点及其相邻顶点的位置和速度。虽然在任何给定时刻计算主动力并不困难，但由于对位置和速度的依赖，结果无法直接积分。这就是为什么它是一个微分方程问题，而不是简单的积分问题。这些微分方程通常不易受到解析解的正面攻击；我们必须使用数值积分。

Suppose we express the velocity of a single cloth vertex as a function of time, approximated as a polynomial (by using its Taylor series expansion; see Section 11.4.6). Assume we know the value at time tk and are interested in only a small interval surrounding tk . Then we could write our approximation in the form
假设我们将单个布料顶点的速度表示为时间函数，近似为多项式（使用其泰勒级数展开式；参见第 11.4.6 节）。假设我们知道时间 tk 处的值，并且只关注 tk 周围的一小段区间。那么，我们可以将近似值写成如下形式：

(12.33) v (tk+h)= v (tk)+h c 1+h2 c 2+h3 c 3+⋯.

Euler integration is known as a first-order method of numerical integration because it matches only up to the first-degree term in this expression, h c 1 , which in this case is simply the acceleration h a (tk) . It is true that h is on the order of 1/60 and in general the higher-order terms decrease rapidly, but we don't know anything about the magnitude of the c 's, so the more terms we can match, the better accuracy can be obtained.21 If the acceleration is constant, then Euler integration would calculate the velocity exactly, but if the forces depended on the position or velocity, then the higher order terms in the expansion, which are ignored by Euler integration, would be nonzero.
欧拉积分被称为一阶数值积分方法，因为它仅匹配此表达式中的一次项 h c 1 ，在本例中即加速度 h a (tk) 。的确， h 的数量级为 1/60，并且一般而言，高阶项会迅速下降，但是我们不知道 c 的大小，因此匹配的项越多，精度就越高。21 如果加速度为常数，则欧拉积分可以精确计算速度，但如果力取决于位置或速度，则展开式中的高阶项（欧拉积分会忽略）将为非零。

In order to improve our results, we will need to use a higher-order method of numerical integration that is able to match more of the terms in Equation (12.33). One common and important technique is Runge-Kutta, and the idea is to take one or more trial steps and sample the forces at different locations. Then the samples from the trial steps are combined in a smart way. The field of numerical integration is a mature one with a large amount of literature and many different well-studied techniques. It would be appropriate to discuss several of these methods in an introductory book that focused only on physics simulation, but we regret that it is just beyond what we can squeeze into a few chapters in this broad introductory book. However, we want to stress two important lessons concerning numerical integration.
为了改进结果，我们需要使用一种能够匹配方程 (12.33) 中更多项的高阶数值积分方法。一种常见且重要的技术是龙格-库塔法，其思想是采取一个或多个试验步骤，在不同位置采样力。然后，以智能方式组合来自试验步骤的样本。数值积分领域已经成熟，拥有大量文献和许多经过充分研究的技术。在一本仅关注物理模拟的入门书中讨论其中几种方法是合适的，但很遗憾，这超出了我们在这本内容广泛的入门书中所能容纳的几章内容。然而，我们想强调关于数值积分的两个重要教训。

The first message has already been delivered: we simply want you to appreciate the shortcomings in Euler integration and be aware that other methods exist that offer different trade-offs among accuracy, stability, and performance. Some integrators are better suited for different purposes. Almost any integrator will work better than Euler integration for the simulations people are currently interested in solving in real-time: cloth, hair, fluid, and soft body simulation, combining dynamic physics and pre-generated animation for articulated (especially humanoid) characters, and others. Anyone interested in these more advanced simulations will find an understanding of integration methods to be a prerequisite. The sources listed in the suggested reading in Section 12.7 are a goodstart.
第一条信息已经传达：我们只是想让您了解欧拉积分的缺点，并意识到存在其他方法，它们在精度、稳定性和性能之间提供不同的权衡。有些积分器更适合不同的目的。对于人们目前感兴趣的实时模拟，几乎任何积分器都比欧拉积分效果更好：布料、毛发、流体和软体模拟，结合动态物理和预生成动画的关节角色（尤其是人形角色）模拟，等等。任何对这些更高级模拟感兴趣的人都会发现，了解积分方法是先决条件。第 12.7 节推荐阅读材料中列出的资料是一个不错的起点。

The second message is that although the higher-order methods are better choices for the “high class” simulations we have named, for simulation of rigid bodies, the trivial Euler integration is still often used. Why? In a word: constraints. In some simulations, the force is a continuous function of time or position, and has a nice Taylor series expansion that is well met by the higher-order integration methods. Simulations based on spring-like connections or those that deal with collisions in a soft, penalty-method-like fashion behave like this. For such simulations, using a higher-order integrator (which increases the number of “inner loop” trial steps and samples per time step) offers a better reduction in error for a given amount of CPU time, compared to reducing h (which takes more “outer loop” iterations). However, the constraints in rigid-body simulations are often discontinuous and inherently require an LCP-based approach. When these discontinuous functions are approximated by Hooke's law, the spring constant must be very large, and this leads to instability. In fact, the resulting differential equations are referred to as “stiff” equations, which are known to require implicit rather than explicit integration. Unfortunately, velocity-based constraint solvers—as we mentioned, these are currently a popular type of simulation—operate by adjusting the velocities to satisfy the constraints, and essentially they need to be able to “see into the future” to know how changes to the proposed adjusted velocity will affect the integrated position and thus the satisfaction of the constraint. More sophisticated methods of integration make this fortune-telling more complicated. (The implicit integration methods used to solve stiff equations essentially operate by “seeing into the future.”) In short, due to the current methods of resolving contact and joint constraints, decreasing the stepsize h offers a more attractive use of CPU time than higher-order integrators, at least according to the votes cast by designs of the more popular real-time rigid-body simulators in use in video games right now. Perhaps put more bluntly: stability is currently valued more than accuracy in real-timesimulation.
第二个信息是，尽管高阶方法对于我们之前提到的“高级”模拟来说是更好的选择，但对于刚体模拟，平凡的欧拉积分仍然经常被使用。为什么？一句话：约束。在某些模拟中，力是时间或位置的连续函数，并且具有良好的泰勒级数展开式，高阶积分方法可以很好地满足这一要求。基于类似弹簧连接的模拟，或以类似惩罚方法的软连接方式处理碰撞的模拟，其行为与此类似。对于此类模拟，使用高阶积分器（这会增加“内循环”试验步骤和每个时间步的样本数）比减少 h （这需要更多“外循环”迭代）在给定的 CPU 时间内可以更好地减少误差。然而，刚体模拟中的约束通常是不连续的，本质上需要基于 LCP 的方法。当用胡克定律近似这些不连续函数时，弹簧常数必须非常大，这会导致不稳定性。事实上，由此产生的微分方程被称为“刚性”方程，众所周知，它们需要隐式积分而非显式积分。遗憾的是，基于速度的约束求解器（正如我们提到的，它们目前是一种流行的模拟类型）通过调整速度来满足约束条件，本质上，它们需要能够“预见未来”，才能知道拟议的调整速度的变化将如何影响积分位置，从而影响约束条件的满足。更复杂的积分方法使这种预测更加复杂。 （用于求解刚性方程的隐式积分法本质上是通过“预见未来”来运作的。）简而言之，由于目前解决接触和关节约束的方法，降低步长 h 比使用高阶积分器更能有效地利用 CPU 时间，至少根据目前在电子游戏中使用的较流行的实时刚体模拟器的设计投票结果来看是如此。或许可以更直白地说：在实时模拟中，稳定性目前比准确性更受重视。

Having brought up numerous complications and then promptly set them aside, we are now ready to present the basic equations for Euler integration of position, velocity, and acceleration.
在提出了许多复杂问题并迅速将它们放在一边之后，我们现在准备提出位置、速度和加速度的欧拉积分的基本方程。

Euler Integration of Acceleration and Velocity
加速度和速度的欧拉积分
a k = f k / m(Newton's second law), v k+1 = v k +h a k (integrate acceleration), p k+1 = p k +h v k+1 (integrate velocity).

These are key operations, so let's see how they might get implemented in C++. The code in Listing 12.7 is a bit easier to read than the equations, since the order of operations makes the subscripting unnecessary.
这些是关键运算，让我们看看如何在 C++ 中实现它们。清单 12.7 中的代码比公式更容易阅读，因为运算顺序使得下标不再必要。

struct Particle {
    Vector3 pos;    // world position of center of mass
    Vector3 linVel; // velocity
    Vector3 force;  // current forces
    float   mass;   // mass of object

    // Take a simple Euler step forward in time by the time step dt
    void eulerIntegrate(float dt) {
        Vector3 acceleration = force / mass;

        linVel += acceleration * dt;
        pos += linVel * dt;
    }
}

12.6.4Integration of Rotation
12.6.4 旋转积分

Now let's say a few words about integration of 3D rotational data. What is the equivalent of p k+1 = p k+h v k for rotation? First, let's present some well-known results from mechanics concerning the relationship between angular velocity and the derivative of orientation values.
现在我们来简单谈谈 3D 旋转数据的积分。旋转的 p k+1 = p k+h v k 对应的是什么？首先，我们来介绍一些力学中关于角速度与方向值导数之间关系的著名结果。

Consider an arbitrary point r fixed on a body that is rotating about its center of mass at an instantaneous angular velocity ω ω . We assume the coordinate space used to describe r has its origin at the body's center of mass, but the axes do not rotate with the body. (In this book, we say that we are expressing the coordinates of the point in “upright space.” These coordinates are also sometimes called “center of mass coordinates.”) Section 11.8.2 showed how to compute the velocity of this vector: v = ω ω × r . This can be written equivalently as
考虑一个任意点 r 固定在一个物体上，该物体绕其质心以瞬时角速度 ω ω 旋转。我们假设用于描述 r 的坐标空间的原点位于物体的质心，但坐标轴不随物体旋转。（在本书中，我们说我们表达的是该点在“直立空间”中的坐标。这些坐标有时也称为“质心坐标”。）第 11.8.2 节展示了如何计算该矢量 v = ω ω × r 的速度。这可以等效地写成

(12.34) r˙ = ω ω × r .

Section 11.8 stated that is it a basic feature of uniform circular motion that the velocity varies continuously due to centripetal acceleration. Since the velocity is not constant, as we've just seen, a simple Euler-step is not accurate: r (t+h)≠ r (t)+h r˙ . However, if we zoom in close enough, a small segment of the circular path starts to look very much like a straight line, and the Euler step isn't that bad. In other words, with a small enough h , or a slow enough angular velocity ω ω , the approximation might be acceptable: r (t+h)≈ r (t)+h r˙ .
11.8 节指出，匀速圆周运动的一个基本特征是速度由于向心加速度而连续变化。由于速度并非恒定，正如我们刚才所见，简单的欧拉步长并不准确： r (t+h)≠ r (t)+h r˙ 。然而，如果我们放大到足够近，圆形路径的一小部分开始看起来很像一条直线，这时欧拉步长就没那么糟糕了。换句话说，如果 h 足够小，或者角速度 ω ω 足够慢，近似值可能是可以接受的： r (t+h)≈ r (t)+h r˙ 。

Everything we've said so far works for any vector r , so let's apply these ideas to the body axes themselves. Remember that the rotation matrix R describes the orientation of the object and rotates row vectors on the left from body space to upright space. The rows of R are formed by the body axes expressed in upright space. What we want to do is apply Equation (12.34) to each body axis (i.e., take the cross product of ω ω with each row). Luckily, we can write the cross product operation as a matrix multiplication (see Exercise 4.8) as
到目前为止，我们所说的一切都适用于任何向量 r ，所以让我们将这些想法应用到身体轴本身上。记住，旋转矩阵 R 描述物体的方向，并将左侧的行向量从身体空间旋转到直立空间。 R 的行由直立空间中表示的身体轴组成。我们要做的是将公式 (12.34) 应用于每个身体轴（即将 ω ω 与每一行进行叉积）。幸运的是，我们可以将叉积运算写成矩阵乘法（参见练习 4.8），如下所示

r˙ = ω ω × r = r [0ωz−ωy−ωz0ωxωy−ωx0] .

Now, the derivative of the rotation matrix can be expressed as the matrix product
现在，旋转矩阵的导数可以表示为矩阵乘积

Derivative of orientation matrix R for an object with angular velocity ω ω
角速度为 ω ω 的物体的方向矩阵 R 的导数
R˙ = R [0ωz−ωy−ωz0ωxωy−ωx0] .

What does this mean? Just as with a single vector r and its derivative r˙ , each element in R˙ gives the derivative of the corresponding element in R . In reality, any particular element of the matrix function R (t) will oscillate within the range [−1,1] . But as before, for small values of h (and small angular velocities ω ω !), a small section of this curved, oscillatory pattern looks like a straight line, and the simple Euler step R k+1 ≈ R k+h R˙ k might be acceptable. However, with rotation matrices, a new wrinkle is present: the resulting matrix is unlikely to be orthonormal. In essence, we are taking Euler steps on each component in isolation, ignoring their interdependence. The solution is to re-orthogonalize the matrix (see Section 6.3.3) after each step.
这是什么意思？就像单个向量 r 及其导数 r˙ 一样， R˙ 中的每个元素都给出 R 中对应元素的导数。实际上，矩阵函数 R (t) 的任何特定元素都会在范围 [−1,1] 内振荡。但与以前一样，对于较小的 h 值（以及较小的角速度 ω ω ！），这种弯曲振荡模式的一小部分看起来像一条直线，简单的欧拉步骤 R k+1 ≈ R k+h R˙ k 可能是可以接受的。然而，对于旋转矩阵，出现了一个新的问题：得到的矩阵不太可能是正交的。本质上，我们孤立地对每个分量采取欧拉步骤，忽略它们的相互依赖性。解决方案是在每一步之后重新正交化矩阵（参见第 6.3.3 节）。

If the orientation of the body is specified by using a quaternion rather than a rotation matrix, the same basic technique can still be used: find the (component-wise) derivative of the orientation, take a simple Euler step on each component independently, and then correct the orientation. With quaternions, the derivative is given by
如果使用四元数而不是旋转矩阵来指定物体的方向，仍然可以使用相同的基本技巧：求方向的（各个分量的）导数，对每个分量独立地进行简单的欧拉步骤，然后校正方向。使用四元数时，导数由下式给出：

Derivative of orientation quaternion q for an object with angular velocity ω ω
对于角速度为 ω ω 的物体，方向四元数 q 的导数
q˙ = 12 ω ω q ,

where the 3D angular velocity vector ω ω has been extended into quaternion space with w=0 . (Eberly [3] derives this result; we will not prove it here.) Note that we do not expect q˙ to be a rotation (unit) quaternion. Neither do we expect the result of Euler integration, q k+1 ≈ q k+h q˙ k to have unit length, and thus it must be normalized.
其中，三维角速度矢量 ω ω 已扩展到四元数空间，其中 w=0 。（Eberly [3] 推导了此结果；我们在此不再证明。）请注意，我们不期望 q˙ 是旋转（单位）四元数。我们也不期望欧拉积分的结果 q k+1 ≈ q k+h q˙ k 具有单位长度，因此必须对其进行归一化。

The technique of integration of orientation just described is a standard one. When using this technique, there are two sources of error. The first is caused by the Euler integration itself, in which we ignore angular acceleration (and higher derivatives) and proceed as if the angular velocity were constant. This error existed with linear data as well as angular; but when integrating linear quantities it was the only source of error. The second source of error is due to the use of component-wise derivatives, which does not take into consideration the interdependence of the components of the rotation matrix or quaternion. This type of error is unique to angular data, since the components of positional data are independent (at least when Cartesian coordinates are used). Fortunately, this source of error can be eliminated.
刚才描述的方向积分技术是一种标准技术。使用这种技术时，有两个误差来源。第一个误差是由欧拉积分本身引起的，在欧拉积分中，我们忽略角加速度（和高阶导数），并将角速度视为常数。这种误差不仅存在于线性数据中，也存在于角度数据中；但在积分线性量时，它是唯一的误差来源。第二个误差来源是由于使用了逐分量导数，这种导数没有考虑旋转矩阵或四元数各分量之间的相互依赖性。这种类型的误差是角度数据所独有的，因为位置数据的各分量是独立的（至少在使用笛卡尔坐标系时）。幸运的是，这种误差来源是可以消除的。

Assume for the moment that the object whose orientation is described by the rotation matrix R or quaternion q is rotating with constant angular velocity ω ω . In this common case, no accuracy is lost by ignoring angular acceleration, but there is a loss in accuracy, which increases with larger h ω ω . The solution is straightforward: determine the finite rotation that would occur in this time step, and then apply the appropriate angular displacement. We already have the tools at our disposal. We convert the rotation h ω ω from exponential map form into axis-angle form (see Section 8.4). This angular displacement can then be converted to a rotation matrix (see Section 5.1.3) or quaternion (see Section 8.5.2), and concatenated with the current rotation. Essentially, what we have done is to choose a better coordinate system in which to perform the Euler integration.
暂时假设方向由旋转矩阵 R 或四元数 q 描述的物体以恒定角速度 ω ω 旋转。在这种常见情况下，忽略角加速度不会损失精度，但会损失精度，并且 h ω ω 越大，精度损失越大。解决方案很简单：确定此时间步长内将发生的有限旋转，然后应用适当的角位移。我们已经有了可用的工具。我们将旋转 h ω ω 从指数映射形式转换为轴角形式（参见第 8.4 节）。然后，可以将此角位移转换为旋转矩阵（参见第 5.1.3 节）或四元数（参见第 8.5.2 节），并与当前旋转连接起来。本质上，我们所做的是选择一个更好的坐标系来执行欧拉积分。

Since it is slightly more expensive to perform the second method, a valid question is: Is it worth it? In the common situation of constant angular velocity, the second method is exact for any step size h , ignoring errors due to floating-point roundoff. In this case, if the angular velocity is high, or the accuracy required is high (e.g., the hands of a clock), then switching to this alternative method will probably be a win. However, the error introduced by Euler integration can interfere with the error introduced by the component-wise derivative method either constructively or destructively, so there is no guarantee that reducing one source of error will actually improve the accuracy of the final result in all cases. This is why the method of integrating angular displacement is an option in some physics engines.
